translations.web: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
translations.bsb: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
translations.asv: And it came to pass the same night, that Jehovah said unto him, Arise, get thee down into the camp; for I have delivered it into thy hand.
